output.title: Values already set global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, which v1.18.0 introduces
output.content: Your values already set `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, and the v1.18.0 release notes say this Helm value is new in that release (ev-861cb2d69752). That means the key may start working once you upgrade from v1.17.0. If it is enabled, cert-manager loses its permission to create pods and HTTP-01 ACME challenges stop working. Check the value you set for this key and whether any issuer in use relies on HTTP-01 challenges; the environment summary does not show either (the CRD inventory is marked absent).
